notes.title: 1.1 Update: Lot's of bugs fixed!
notes.notes:
Hello campers, 

Here's an exciting list of features and bugfixes:

[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Motion Blur is disabled by default, and an option is added to the graphics settings.
    [*]Additional instructions on the screen to prevent confusion.
    [*]Provided cooking tools are idle, player can now put off the fire and then ignite again.
    [*]The cup noodles are meant to be put in the cooking pot, and the "Press LMB" indicator is now added  as an instruction.
    [*]Levels start at 15:00 instead of 16:00. This gives player a little more time to explore before sunset. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Fixed a game-breaking bug where the player couldn't cook the next day if he/she slept hungry.
    [*]Fixed a game-breaking bug where the player couldn't leave after placing all the items back into the car in the morning.
     [*]Fixed a game-breaking bug where the player couldn't place objects, when played on low-end computers.
     [*]Fixed a game-breaking bug where the player didn't sleep at night, but couldn't sleep the next day to complete the quest.
    [*]Fixed the head lamp alignment, now aimed properly.
    [*]Fixed the Q button. Now works properly to hide and show the quest list.
    [*]Ambient nature sound is now working properly on the lakeside level.
    [*]Fixed a bug where the driver door was outlined even though leaving was not an option yet.
[/list]

Enjoy the nature!

notes.title: Working on a Hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hello campers, 

We have encountered a few bugs and we started working on them immediately. We would like to share them with you, to let you know we are aware that:

[list]
    [*]If the player sleeps before starting a fire and eating dinner, the player will not be able to proceed to pack up and leave the next day.
    [*]There is an extremely rare bug that's keeping the player from placing the cooking pot onto the cooking tripod. We are investigating.
    [*]Another rare bug is not being able to leave after placing all the items back into the car in the morning. 
[/list]

There are also some minor issues we are looking into, but these are the main glitches we are focused on. Please stay tuned for hotfixes.

notes.title: LET'S GO CAMPING!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]WOW[/b]. A busy night in the woods. Where have all these campers come from?[/h3]

Indeed, this is an exciting night: The peaceful camping game you have been waiting for has just been reelased on Steam! Get it on the launch sale and [b]save an extra 10%[/b]!

Please do enjoy the game and feel free to report any bugs/glitches in the official Discussions page. We spent quite some time to testing and everything was cool. Even if you encounter problems, will be working on a fix soon.

notes.title: Coming Closer to Completion
notes.notes:
Hello fans and friends!

We are getting closer every day to the completion of our beloved game. Everything is in pretty good shape so far, all systems up and running, few bugs here and there.

If everything goes as planned, CVS2024 will be released in mid-February. We tried hard to create an immersive camping experience with limited time and budget, but this turned out to be such a special project in our hearts.

We sincerely hope the players will enjoy the experience, as we did while developing it.

Meanwhile, stay tuned for exciting news!
